description: Cloudflare Workers platform limits and runtime gotchas

entries.bad_pattern: Binding user/data-derived strings into SQL LIKE patterns (`%token%`) without capping their length
entries.good_pattern: Cap LIKE pattern bind values to <=48 bytes (50-byte D1 limit minus the two % wildcards) before binding
entries.description: Remote Cloudflare D1 enforces a 50-byte maximum LIKE/GLOB pattern length and throws "D1_ERROR: LIKE or GLOB pattern too complex: SQLITE_ERROR" beyond it. Local wrangler dev (miniflare) uses stock SQLite with a ~50KB limit, so the bug ONLY appears in production. Hit 2026-06-11: a related-research query bound a 70-byte canonical-query token (clarification metadata like "use_case:equalmix.-some-of-my-kids-art...") and one migrated page 500'd remotely while rendering fine locally with identical data.
entries.context: Any D1 query using LIKE with bound patterns derived from queries/slugs/tokens
